The main takeaway from our work is that
the solid-phase extracted DOMSPE is a good indicator for the organic complexation of trace elements and can be used as a proxy for the complexation of trace metal in the original water.
the combination of SPE and UV treatment is a powerful tool to quantify trace element complexation in DOM of different salinities.
